patches.basis: The immutable source explicitly starts its middle-strain repeat at bar 8, quarter 2, but LilyPond 2.24 suppresses the signs of a count-one repeat. Restore that already-encoded opening marker as a visible repeat barline without unfolding or changing any music.

Restore the corresponding already-encoded closing repeat marker at bar 16, quarter 2. The skip durations and all note expressions remain unchanged; the source pitch/onset multiset must match the immutable published MIDI.

bars.description: Play the opening pickup and bars 1–8, repeat the middle eight-bar span from the last quarter of bar 8 up to (but not including) the last quarter of bar 16, then continue to bar 24. The central repeat uses exact quarter offsets, not a whole-bar substitute.
